text_to_image_prompt: Create one image of A visibly elderly male werewolf clan elder in fully human form, apparent human age late 60s. Deep espresso brown knee-length wool overcoat over charcoal waistcoat and tailored trousers, ivory shirt, muted dark taupe tie, small antique bronze geometric lapel pin, brown leather dress shoes. Upright tall dignified lean frame; retain credible aged anatomy. Premium semi-realistic adult otome romance-game 2.5D/3D character render with finely sculpted facial planes, dimensional eyes, individually resolved dry hair strands, subtle natural skin microtexture, physically credible wool and silk. Clean white seamless studio background, broad soft neutral frontal illumination, refined high-detail materials, no color cast, no text, labels, logo, watermark, UI, extra people, wolf ears or fangs. One landscape 3:2 sheet arranged as a clean 3-column by 2-row grid of six head-and-shoulder camera studies: left-facing three-quarter, right-facing three-quarter, exact left profile, exact right profile, slightly elevated frontal view and slightly low frontal view. The same adult identity at the same scale in all cells, clearly distinct rotations, full hair, no duplicated angle and no text.

original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a premium otome 2.5D/3D CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET for Harland Royce. The supplied portrait is the exact identity, hair, facial geometry, skin color, eye color, outfit and rendering-quality master. Preserve all those across panels, detailed hair strands, sculptural skin and fabric. White studio background, neutral soft light, no text, no watermark, no new accessories, no character redesign, no change of age, no stretched neck or deformed facial anatomy. All panels show this SAME adult character. One landscape 3:2 sheet arranged as a clean 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX bust views, full hair and shoulders visible with comfortable consistent margins. Views in reading order: front-left three-quarter (45 degrees), front-right three-quarter (45 degrees), exact left profile (90 degrees), exact right profile (90 degrees), slightly elevated frontal view (camera 15 degrees above eye level), slightly low frontal view (camera 10 degrees below eye level).
